categories.main_business_segments: VICI Properties operates as a single business segment focused on owning and acquiring experiential real estate assets, primarily in the gaming, hospitality, wellness, entertainment, and leisure sectors. Its portfolio includes 54 gaming properties and 39 other experiential properties, as well as four championship golf courses and undeveloped land, all subject to long-term triple-net leases.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core business model is based on acquiring, owning, and leasing real estate assets under long-term triple-net leases, where tenants are responsible for all property-level operating expenses, maintenance, taxes, and insurance. VICI also originates real estate debt investments and provides capital for property improvements through its Partner Property Growth Fund, earning incremental rent in return.
categories.primary_customers_markets: VICI’s primary customers are leading gaming and experiential operators, including Caesars Entertainment and MGM Resorts, which together account for approximately 74% of annualized rent. The company also serves operators in wellness, sports, family entertainment, and hospitality sectors, with end markets including casinos, hotels, convention centers, golf resorts, and entertainment complexes.
categories.geographic_coverage: VICI’s portfolio is geographically diverse, spanning 26 U.S. states and Canada, with a significant concentration on the Las Vegas Strip, which generates about 48% of total revenues. The company also owns properties in major urban, destination, and regional markets across North America, and has exposure to international assets through select investments.
categories.supply_chain_position: VICI operates as a real estate landlord and capital provider, functioning downstream in the supply chain by owning the physical assets and leasing them to operators who manage the day-to-day business. It does not operate the properties but provides capital and real estate solutions to tenants and borrowers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, VICI focuses on expanding its portfolio through acquisitions, sale-leaseback transactions, and real estate debt investments, with an emphasis on experiential assets. The company pursues embedded growth via rights of first refusal, call options, and its Partner Property Growth Fund, and is increasingly targeting non-gaming experiential sectors and international opportunities. ESG and sustainability initiatives are also a growing area of focus.
categories.revenue_model: VICI generates the vast majority of its revenue from long-term, triple-net lease rental income, which is contractually escalated and often linked to inflation (CPI). Additional revenue streams include interest income from real estate debt investments, golf course operations, and incremental rent from capital improvement funding.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: VICI competes with other publicly traded and private REITs, investment companies, private equity, sovereign funds, and gaming companies for property acquisitions and tenants. It is one of the largest experiential REITs, with a leading position in the gaming real estate sector and a growing presence in broader experiential assets, benefiting from scale, high-quality tenants, and long lease terms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, VICI had total assets of $45.4 billion and annual revenues of $3.85 billion, with net income attributable to common stockholders of $2.68 billion. The company has demonstrated strong growth since its 2017 formation, completing over $37 billion in investments, and was added to the S&P 500 in 2022. Revenue and AFFO grew by 6.6% and 8.4% year-over-year, respectively, in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: VICI offers investors stable, predictable, and inflation-protected cash flows through long-term, triple-net leases with leading operators, high occupancy, and contractual rent escalations. Its high-quality, iconic assets—especially on the Las Vegas Strip—create high barriers to entry, while its Partner Property Growth Fund and embedded growth pipeline provide avenues for future expansion and rent growth. The company emphasizes transparency, tenant quality, and a collaborative approach to capital investment and property enhancement.
